name: Langa (Spain)
description: Red field charged at the centre with the crowned municipal arms of Langa (a livestock gate on yellow above a tower and waves).
history: The arms and the flag were approved officially on 7 March 1994 (Boletín Oficial del Estado no. 80 of 4 April 1994); the flag is rectangular, one metre at the hoist by two metres in the fly, red, with the municipal arms at the centre.

features.role: Langa arms — livestock gate, tower and waves
